title: July victims
summary: The English Wikipedia article "July victims", at revision 1309446389, opens: "The July victims were members of the Croatian People's Party who fell victim to a crackdown by the Austrian Imperial Army on July 29, 1845." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6310687, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item carries no description in English or Portuguese. Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
